name: Coalition
provenance: Fourteen scheduled classroom footprints on B and L1 are manually traced from the public March 2025 FIS master-plan rasters. C125/C126, C127/C128 and CB27/CB28 are combined, partitionable rooms under keys 125, 127 and B27. All ten original floor levels and approximate campus-footprint slabs are retained. Six L2 classrooms remain floor-listed without geometry. Metric scale, campus registration and heights are approximate; this is partial interior geometry, not a complete as-built model.

coordinateSystem.description: Meters in the existing campus-footprint frame. Traced B/L1 pixels are scaled using printed C130 area and rigidly aligned to exterior corners; held-out campus discrepancy reaches 1.51 m.
